summary: Verified P2 maintainability refactor extracting 10 service-tile arrays + TAXI_VISUAL/TAXI_DEFAULT from UserHome.js (~710 lines) into pages/user/userHomeServices.js. No regressions detected. Zero JS runtime errors, zero ReferenceError for icons/arrays (no 'taxiServices is not defined', no 'Truck is not defined'). Zero broken images.
